preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 200000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value a_i must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: The number of edges must be n-1, and each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible cost of the tree as a string.
